tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events. The system should be able to send notifications to users in a timely manner. The system should also be able to handle different notification channels such as email, in-app notifications, and push notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has enabled notifications, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 5 minutes.

tasks.description: Identify important events that should trigger notifications and implement event triggers. Event triggers should be able to capture relevant event data and pass it to the notification system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an important event occurs, when the event trigger is activated, then the event data is passed to the notification system.

tasks.description: Design and create notification templates for different types of events. Notification templates should be customizable and able to handle different notification channels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template, when the template is rendered, then the notification is displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Implement a system to control the frequency of notifications sent to users. The system should be able to handle different notification frequencies such as daily, weekly, or monthly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has set a notification frequency, when an event occurs, then the user receives notifications at the specified frequency.

tasks.description: Implement a system to allow users to customize their notification preferences. Users should be able to choose which types of events they want to receive notifications for and how often they want to receive notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has customized their notification preferences, when an event occurs, then the user receives notifications according to their preferences.

tasks.description: Write comprehensive tests for the notification system to ensure it is working correctly. Tests should cover different scenarios such as event triggers, notification templates, and notification frequency control.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test scenario, when the test is run, then the notification system behaves as expected.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing events to new notification system
tasks.description: Migrate existing events to the new notification system. This includes updating event triggers and notification templates to work with the new system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing event, when the event is migrated, then the event is triggered and notification is sent correctly.
